exposure: Pre-echographic limiting score (derived from maternal characteristics: obesity, retroverted uterus, myomas, previous abdominal surgery, limited echo-absorption)
cohort: The study included 445 singleton pregnant women with one or more limiting features undergoing routine gestational ultrasound at 11-14 weeks and 19-21 weeks of gestation.
finding: Operator's satisfaction with sonographic examination was significantly and inversely related to the pre-echographic limiting score, independent of maternal age, operator, hospital center, or examination duration.
cross-section timing: Routine gestational ultrasound at 11-14 weeks and 19-21 weeks of gestation
